messages.text: Hello when will more be available for purchase
Searched the catalog · Airsquitter 4DSKY

Good timing — the Standard Antenna (USA) at $985.83 is buyable right now. The U. bonus-antenna bundle is the one that's out; the EU + NZ bonus version at $1,225.83 is live too.

Which one were you after, and where's it shipping?
The U. bonus antenna bundle was the one i was wanting

That one's out of stock and I don't have a restock date for it — I won't guess one. I've put the question to the team and they'll confirm by email, usually within one business day.

Meanwhile the Standard Antenna (USA) at $985.83 is live and ships with the same unit, antenna, cables, clamps and plug — just without the bonus antenna. Want me to build that cart?
Handed to the team · No restock date available for the US bonus-antenna Airsquitter variant
Stay in the chat if you can — someone from the team can jump in here with the restock date. If you step away, it'll come by email.
Can the bonus antenna be added later?
Searched the catalog · 1090mhz antenna add-on

Not as a separate product — the bonus antenna only exists as part of that bundle variant, there's no standalone antenna SKU on the store. So buying the standard now wouldn't let you tack it on later at the bundle price.

I've already asked the team for the restock date on the US bundle, so you'll have that to decide with. Want me to hold off on the cart until then?
I would like to wait on the team for a restock date
Used the chat-interview skill

Understood — the team has it and will come back with that date, by email if you've stepped away.

Before you go, one thing: what's making the bonus antenna the must-have over the standard one?
I would buy one now if I could buy the out of stock antenna at a later date without a discount

That's a fair ask, and not one I can answer myself — there's no standalone antenna SKU today, so whether the team can sell you one separately later is their call. I've put it to Georges with your restock question; he can pick it up right here.

If he says yes, the Standard Antenna (USA) at $985.83 is live and I can build that cart in a second.
Handed to the team · Ready to buy but blocked: wants to buy the bonus antenna separately later at ful
Stay in the chat if you can — Georges can answer both here. Otherwise it'll come by email, usually within one business day.
okay I have been waiting a long time, is georges coming to chat?

Sorry about the wait. He's on today and your case is in his queue with both questions on it; I've nudged it again. If he doesn't reach you here, the answer comes by email, usually within one business day.

Nothing is lost if you close the tab.

Hang tight here if you can — he can answer both in this chat.
iv never given you my email?

You're right, you haven't — my mistake for saying email.

Drop your email here and I'll put it on the case so Georges can reach you if you leave the chat. Otherwise the answer waits for you right here.
(email hidden)

Either he catches you here or it lands in your inbox.
